status: registered before any v4 episode is scored; freeze4.json holds the digests of this file, world4.py and run4.py before the v4 run
motivation_from_v3: v3 (README section 3.3) showed the class-template world cannot certify any planner decision (tau = +inf) and the structural (structure-neighbour) channel fits lambda = 0. The v3 mechanism analysis identifies the missing core as a compound-level predictive: the oracle's advantage is knowing the compound's actual readings. The dual-core question reduces to whether the virtual cell can predict the compound's own next reading from its own previous readings well enough for margin calibration to survive planning
inherits_from_v2_v3: data, units, folds, classes, menu pool, per-episode menu, charged-QC rule, budget 16
the score-margin validator and per-arm tau calibration on training-fold split halves
the greedy expected-margin planner (TOP_H = 8, K = 7 quantile points)
non-profile arms are imported unchanged from the frozen v3 run (identical code path, identical folds and templates): oracle, planner_reference, fixed_informative, random, planner_shuffled

world4_profile_channel.definition: for a held-out compound with purchased readings at lines J (values a_J), the profile prediction for an unpurchased line L is prof(L) = sum_i sim_i * A_i(L) / sum_i sim_i over training compounds i with a measured A_i(L), where sim_i = exp(-d_i / scale_d), d_i = mean over purchased lines j in J of (A_i(j) - a_j)^2 on jointly finite coordinates, and scale_d = the median of d_i over training compounds
world4_profile_channel.blend: the predictive mean per hypothesis is mu_c(L) = (1 - beta) * m_c(L) + beta * prof(L), scale s_c(L) unchanged; beta fitted per fold on training reading log-likelihood over the grid {0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0}, profile neighbours excluding the fitted compound's own unit
world4_profile_channel.fitting_approximation: for beta fitting, profile distances use every pool line (the target line contributes one of about 400 coordinates; per-line exclusion is not applied)
world4_profile_channel.cold_start: with no purchased readings the predictive is the class template (beta irrelevant)
world4_profile_channel.masked_control: planner_profile_masked runs the same planner with the compound's purchased readings replaced by another held-out compound's readings at the same positions (permuted within fold); if profile ~= masked the channel is not compound-specific
world4_profile_channel.shuffled_control: planner_profile_shuffled runs on readings permuted between episodes within the fold

arms.planner_profile: the v3 planner with the profile-conditioned world (world mean updated after every purchase)

dual_core_questions: does the compound-level channel certify decisions: planner_profile coverage and conditional wrong at its calibrated tau
how much of the oracle ceiling it recovers: planner_profile correct / oracle correct, and the measurements gap
channel value over the class template: planner_profile - planner_reference
artifact checks: planner_profile_shuffled coverage <= 0.10 and correct <= half of planner_profile
gate_v4: planner_profile - planner_reference > 0 correct decisions with a bootstrap interval
